name: SiYuan
description: Privacy-first knowledge base with blocks, backlinks and Markdown

paths.name: Workspace
paths.description: Your notebooks, settings, history and this install's access code (.icestore-access-code). Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: SiYuan web app, published on host as 6807

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: SIYUAN_LANG
variables.description: The language of the app, like en, de, fr, ja or zh-CN. Remove it to keep the language you pick in Settings.
